test_title: SSC CGL 2025 Tier-I Similar Paper (Held On: 12th September 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: X is able to complete a task in 12 days, while Y takes 18 days to finish the same task. If they collaborate and work together for 3 days, what fraction of the work will still remain?
solution:
**Given:**

X can do the work in 12 days

Y can do the work in 18 days

**Formula used:**

Work = LCM of days

Efficiency = Work ÷ Time

Work done in 3 days = 3 × (Efficiency of X + Efficiency of Y)
